headline: Mercosur-EU Trade Pact Boosts Brazilian Exports by 21%
summary: Brazilian exports of tariff-reduced or eliminated goods to the European Union increased by 21% during the first five months of the Mercosur-EU agreement's provisional implementation.
why: Trade agreements can significantly alter export volumes and revenue for agricultural and industrial sectors in participating nations.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Provisional trade agreement implementation boosted exports.
